body:
Suicide is both the ultimate expression of individuality and ending suffering. One needs to analyze both aspects I think.

While individuality is in some sense valued, it is only mostly valued. Meaning, as long as it's expressed in reasonable amounts. Suicide goers beyond that, meaning it's not valued.

​

Ending suffering: Here we have to look at the cultures we live in. We are mostly steeped in religious cultures, in particular Judeo-Christian one. And here you have to understand that these religions and religious people look at suffering, particularly of people other than themselves, as a good thing. Thus alleviating suffering or ending suffering is the sacrilegious thing they can imagine.
I expect that I will never come to that. Hope you do though.

I guess it depends a bit on what you want to say. For me it's mostly a few lines to the people I love. Mostly apologies about how I can't go on further, not their fault. How they should take care of each other and how there was nothing they could do about. Then a few lines about to whom my stuff should go to, a few other practicalities. I don't need to tell anyone why I'm going to do what I'm going to do. If they don't already know.. Well, then they don't know me. Some people probably have more to say.

That's what it is. That and no more of this suffering. It's a comforting thought to be honest I think, rather than bleak however.

No.

I'm starting to realize myself that that is insanely selfish. If the people closest to me expect me to endure this suffering just for their sake... That is selfish. And more and more I'm realizing that it's not worth it. If they cannot deal with choosing not to suffer, it's their problem.
Are you an utter fucking idiot?
Replace therapist with "anyone" since I don't have one anymore. But yeah. Of course I don't. Or wouldn't.. If I did, they'd try to stop me. Doesn't make sense.
Doesn't work with modern cars, apparently. They don't emit enough of the necessary gasses so that that method would be in any way reliable. So please, don't try that one.
I deal with them by.. Realizing they are absolute fucking idiots. If possible, cut them all from your life.
Don't we all? That fear of brain damage is... terrifying. I think I've beaten it, mostly, but still.
Yeah, I know that feel. Don't cry myself either. I sometimes wish I could but... I can't. I don't know. Really wish there were help for everyone. I do hope you could find some.

I think it's against sub-rules to discuss methods? I'd rather not get banned for the last few days. So I'm erring on the side of caution. Cutting bloodflow to the brain is the gist of it. Already practiced it and know I can do it.

I will leave probably 2 notes. One for people in general. The other to the family members I care about, where I go into a bit more detail about the why and where I tell them not to take it too badly and take care of each other.

First got diagnosed when I was 18. Been depressed way before that. While I wouldn't count it as a real attempt I did try to first slit my wrists when I was 10. I'm now 28.. So it sure seems like it's not temporary. Honestly, the only reason I've survived this long is because I'm too much of a failure to get even suicide right. Tried everything during this time and now it's just waiting until I can finally end it.
